title: Gate Rust peer-generation allocator to its production owner features
description: lichen-link no-default build emits dead_code warnings because NEXT_PEER_KEY_GENERATION and PeerKeyGeneration::allocate exist without the schnorr+std-gated LinkLayer that owns generation allocation. Gate allocator state/method to the same features so no-default remains warning-free while the opaque token type remains available to no_std upper layers.
notes: Feature-gated runtime/durable generation allocators and replay persistence helpers to their std+schnorr owner; no-default build is warning-free and all-target clippy passes.
